risks.risk: The actual screen size may be significantly smaller than 86 inches.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's sticker on the back of the unit.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a 55-inch model (the baseline for 'large' TVs).

risks.risk: The screen may have dead pixels, vertical lines, or burn-in not visible in a landscape photo.
risks.proof: A video of the screen cycling through solid red, green, blue, and white backgrounds.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a defective panel.

risks.risk: The HDMI or other input ports may be physically damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A photo of the port array and a clip showing a device successfully connecting.

risks.risk: The original remote control may be missing or broken.
risks.proof: A photo of the remote control next to the TV.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model and serial number sticker on the back of the TV.
Video of the TV displaying a solid white screen to check for panel uniformity and dead pixels.
Photo of the input ports on the back/side.
response.reason: The model number and screen size are the primary determinants of value for this item and are currently unverified. Without the back label, it is impossible to distinguish between a high-end 86-inch model and a much cheaper, smaller series.
